create.name: J. Brown
create.bio:
Based in Brooklyn, New York, where he founded Abhyasa Yoga Center, J. Brown teaches yoga, writes and hosts a podcast. He came to yoga while grieving his mother's death and trained first in Ashtanga and power vinyasa, then in an Iyengar-based approach, studying with teachers including Alison West and Richard Freeman, before settling on a slower, breath-led way of practising drawn from the tradition of T.K.V. Desikachar. His short motto is that slower is stronger and gentle is advanced, and he has taught for more than twenty-five years.

He now teaches weekly classes that are held in person and streamed live, runs a weekly discussion group for teachers, and leads a mentoring-based teacher training with 200, 300 and 500-hour routes. He is best known for J. Brown Yoga Talks, a long-running interview podcast that reached its 500th episode in 2026, in which he talks at length with yoga teachers, scholars and practitioners about philosophy, practice and the yoga business; full episodes also appear on his YouTube channel. His monthly essays, written over a decade, are collected on his blog and read aloud in a second show, Yoga Thoughts.

courses.title: Live Class Subscription
courses.description: Unlimited access to J. Brown's weekly classes, taught in person in Brooklyn and streamed at the same time, with a day's replay of the latest week. Slow, breath-led sessions open to students and teachers.

courses.title: Teacher Training: 'Gentle is the New Advanced'
courses.description: A rolling-admission deep-learning programme that mixes one-to-one mentoring, group discussion and a large on-demand library, leading to 200, 300 or 500-hour certification. Classes run live online and in person.

courses.title: Yoga Talks Premium
courses.description: A listener subscription that opens the complete archive of full-length Yoga Talks conversations, most running ninety minutes or more, and helps fund the show.

free_resources.title: J. Brown Yoga Talks podcast
free_resources.description: A weekly long-form interview show in which J. Brown talks with yoga teachers, scholars and practitioners about practice, teaching and the yoga world. Free episodes are published online.

free_resources.title: Yoga Thoughts podcast
free_resources.description: His monthly blog essays read aloud by J. Brown himself, about ten years of writing on practice and on yoga's path into the mainstream. Free to listen to.

free_resources.title: J. Brown's blog
free_resources.description: A decade of monthly essays on yoga practice, teaching and the yoga industry, free to read.
